name: ProjectIntake
title: Templates/Platform/States/ProjectIntake
summary: The surfaces a project passes through when it is dropped on the page: the dashed drop target that fills the page while a folder hovers over it, then the full-screen Initializing overlay that reads like the deploy logs: one row per received file as a step, its status glyph (a check once uploaded, a Spinner while it runs, a dashed ring while queued), the path and its size, advancing row by row, over the upload summary. A home page, its empty state, a creation hub and a project detail page render the drop target (the project page swaps the copy for “We build a new version of web-app, then you choose where it goes live.”); the home page, its empty state and the creation hub render Initializing over themselves. Built from `CardBox`, `Spinner`, Vue’s Transition and plain elements on theme tokens, with the step-row anatomy of the DeploymentLogs template.

variants.name: Initializing
variants.summary: The Initializing overlay mid-upload, held inside a layout-contained frame here so it does not cover the docs page: two files uploaded, the third running, two queued, each row a step with its status glyph, path and size.
